adm.title: Stony Brook — Admitted International Students (I-20, proof of financial support)

test_policy.notes: Test optional for applicants (scores sent by the testing agency are considered if submitted). CDS C8F: SAT or ACT is required for the Scholars for Medicine and Scholars for Dental Medicine honors programs.

requirements.notes: International applicants use the Common App or the SUNY App (no separate international application); the domestic first-year page also lists the Coalition App. $50 fee. One essay on a topic of choice. ONE letter of recommendation from a teacher or counselor (two teacher letters for honors programs; one from a science/math teacher for WISE). Three most recent years of secondary grades in English. Honors College / WISE / University Scholars need a ~250-word honors statement via the StartSBU portal.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 Early Action
deadlines.notes: Completion deadline: all required materials (application, recommendation, transcripts) must be received. Also the priority deadline for the Honors College, WISE and University Scholars; Simons STEM Scholars is due Nov 1.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Completion deadline. Honors programs (excluding Simons STEM) final deadline is Jan 15; later applications are considered on a space-available basis.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants from native English-speaking countries, and international applicants who attend an English-medium school, are exempt from submitting English proficiency scores. Other accepted evidence: SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 19, IB HL English 5, AP English Language or Literature 3, A-level English C, GaoKao English 125/150, CSAT rank 1. Applicants not meeting the criteria may be considered for conditional admission.

aid.notes: Not confirmed for international students: the scholarships page says all incoming first-year applicants are considered for merit scholarships (most need no separate application) and mentions the FAFSA for need-based awards, but it does not say whether international students are eligible. Admitted international students must document proof of financial support for one year to receive an I-20.

tier_notes.business: Business Management B.S. is small and not highly ranked.
